Hi Logan —

Thanks for taking this call last week. SecureBridge is finalizing our SOC2 evidence flow and we want to evaluate a live GRC connector to pull artifact metadata and temporary access (timeboxed) for auditors. High level asks from our side: 

- A routing/custody map that describes where artifacts live (S3 buckets, KMS keys) and what level of live access Redwood can provide versus exported snapshots.
- An SLA for on-demand access windows (target: < 2 hours to grant auditor access) and escalation contacts.
- Evidence retention & redaction controls (we need tokenized access for customer data).
- Confirmation you can support our KMS/HSM patterns or a proxy for zero-knowledge key handling.

I attached a draft NDA and a short diagram the SOC team asked for. Can you loop in the partner/sales ops and engineering contact so we can scope a mutual action plan? Our audit window is early March so we need to finalize integration by mid-February.

Thanks,

Tamara —

Appreciate the clear asks. I'll own coordinating scope from our side. Quick responses inline: 

- Custody map: we can produce a per-account map that shows storage locations, object prefixes, and whether items are covered by prefix-level KV caching vs. persisted snapshots. We'll confirm which buckets are candidate for time-limited access.
- SLA: we can commit to a 2-hour standard for pre-authorized auditor requests (requires an allowlist and RBAC policy). For ad-hoc requests we propose a 6-hour SLA unless a pre-approved escalation is in place.
- Retention/redaction: Redwood supports field-level redaction and a tokenization proxy; need to confirm with engineering for your KMS pattern.
- KMS/HSM: we have a KMS integration path (customer-managed key option) but if you require HSM-backed key custody we will need a short architecture review.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Quick intake sync (30m) this week to validate storage & KMS patterns.
2) Monica will draft a one-page operational runbook and proposed SLA.
3) Exchange and sign NDA (I see you attached the draft; thanks).

Looping in Monica (Partner Ops) and Marissa (Security Programs) to pick up the technical details. Monica — can you confirm availability this week? Marissa — if you have checklist items for the redaction/tokenization story please flag.

—Logan
